name: account-discovery
description:
Builds a list of companies that match an ideal customer profile (ICP), each with the
reason it fits and a source, using the Nimble `account-discovery` agent template on live
web data. Use when the user says "find companies like", "build a prospect list", "ICP
list", "find accounts that match", "target account list", "companies that fit our ICP",
or arrives from a Nimble use-case page. Interviews the user for the inputs, shows quick
search results first, then runs the template at medium and high effort and shows each
result as it arrives. Do NOT use to research one known company (use account-brief) or to
find investment targets (use deal-sourcing).
